FROM group_member gm JOIN members m ON m.member_id = gm.member_id LEFT JOIN region r ON r.region_id = m.region_id WHERE gm.group_id = #{groupId} AND gm.member_role != 'OWNER' AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND gm.membership_status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED')
AND gm.membership_status = #{status}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT CAST(gm.crew_member_id AS CHAR) AS crew_member_id, CONCAT(LEFT(m.name, 1), REPEAT('*', GREATEST(CHAR_LENGTH(m.name) - 1, 1))) AS applicant, r.region_name, (m.identity_verified_at IS NOT NULL) AS identity_verified, (m.region_verified_at IS NOT NULL) AS region_verified, gm.application_message, gm.membership_status
ORDER BY gm.requested_at DESC, gm.crew_member_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql: FROM saving_group sg JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = sg.group_id JOIN region r ON r.region_id = g.region_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO groups ( region_id, member_id, group_name, description, max_members, created_at ) VALUES ( #{regionId}, #{memberId}, #{groupName}, #{description}, #{maxMembers}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() )

INSERT INTO saving_group ( group_id, saving_group_type, dues_amount, dues_day, start_date, end_date, status, group_image ) VALUES ( #{groupId}, #{savingGroupType}, #{duesAmount}, #{duesDay}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, 'pending', #{groupImagePath} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT sg.saving_group_id, g.group_id, g.group_name, g.description, r.region_name, g.max_members, sg.dues_amount, sg.dues_day, sg.status
ORDER BY g.created_at DESC, sg.saving_group_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT member_id, account_status, identity_verified_at FROM members WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT sg.saving_group_id, sg.group_id, sg.status, g.max_members, g.member_id AS owner_member_id FROM saving_group sg JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = sg.group_id WHERE sg.saving_group_id = #{savingGroupId} AND g.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT crew_member_id, member_role, membership_status FROM group_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND member_id = #{memberId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM group_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND membership_status = 'APPROVED' FOR UPDATE

FOR UPDATE

UPDATE group_member SET member_role = 'MEMBER', membership_status = 'PENDING',
approved_by = NULL, approved_at = NULL, joined_at = NULL, left_at = NULL, application_message = NULL, requested_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND membership_status = 'LEFT'
mapper.select: SELECT sg.saving_group_id, sg.group_id, g.member_id AS group_leader_member_id, owner.owner_member_id, sg.status FROM saving_group sg JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = sg.group_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT group_id, MAX(member_id) AS owner_member_id FROM group_member WHERE member_role = 'OWNER' AND membership_status = 'APPROVED' GROUP BY group_id ) owner ON owner.group_id = g.group_id WHERE sg.saving_group_id = #{savingGroupId} AND g.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT g.group_name, g.description, g.max_members, COALESCE(approved.approved_member_count, 0) AS approved_member_count, sg.dues_amount, sg.dues_day FROM saving_group sg JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = sg.group_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT group_id, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS approved_member_count FROM group_member WHERE membership_status = 'APPROVED' GROUP BY group_id ) approved ON approved.group_id = g.group_id WHERE sg.saving_group_id = #{savingGroupId} AND g.deleted_at IS NULL

dues_amount = #{change.duesAmount},

mapper.select: SELECT setting_change_id, group_id, dues_amount, dues_day, effective_at, status, applied_at, canceled_at FROM saving_group_setting_change WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND effective_at <= #{appliedAt} ORDER BY effective_at ASC, setting_change_id ASC
SELECT sg.status FROM saving_group sg JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = sg.group_id WHERE sg.group_id = #{groupId} AND g.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT setting_change_id, group_id, dues_amount, dues_day, effective_at, status, applied_at, canceled_at FROM saving_group_setting_change WHERE setting_change_id = #{settingChangeId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND effective_at <= #{appliedAt} FOR UPDATE

UPDATE saving_group
dues_amount = #{change.duesAmount},
dues_day = #{change.duesDay},
WHERE group_id = #{change.groupId}
UPDATE saving_group_setting_change SET status = 'APPLIED', applied_at = #{appliedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE setting_change_id = #{settingChangeId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE saving_group_setting_change SET status = 'HELD', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE saving_group_setting_change SET status = 'CANCELED', canceled_at = #{canceledAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'HELD')

UPDATE saving_group_setting_change SET status = 'PENDING', effective_at = CASE WHEN effective_at < #{resumedAt} THEN #{nextEffectiveAt} ELSE effective_at END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND status = 'HELD'
